newsitem.title: USA: Limited, investment firm launch venture.
newsitem.headline: Limited, investment firm launch venture.

text.p: New York investment firm Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe and Ohio-based retailer Limited Inc launched a joint venture credit card transaction processing firm, Alliance Data Systems Corp, Alliance said Monday.

It resulted from the merger of Limited's World Financial Network Holding Corp credit-card issuing bank unit and Business Services Holdings Inc's BSI Business Services Inc transaction processing unit, Alliance said in a statement.
The investment firm will own 60 percent and Limited will own 40 percent, Alliance said. Welsh Carson acquired BSI from J.C. Penney Co Inc earlier this year, Alliance said.
Limited's credit card bank unit began operating as a joint venture with the investment firm last year. Limited said previously the unit would provide services to other retailers.

Alliance said it offers private label credit card transaction processing, network and subscriber services, merchant banking and database and credit card marketing for retail, petroleum, casual dining and satellite television industries. It will also continue processing credit card transactions for Limited's retail divisions, it said.
Ralph Spurgin, president of BSI and World Financial Network, will be president of Dallas-based Alliance.
